reconstruction_choices: Nominal and learned policies share native BlueSky motion, admissions, terminal recording and metrics. No conflict, width or altitude violation silently deletes an aircraft.
Control is applied on global five-second boundaries. Aircraft admitted between boundaries fly nominally until their first observation; their preceding physical exposure remains counted.

Reward uses the post-transition physical snapshot and accepted instruction cost once per decision; arriving or timing-out aircraft are scored before deletion. Exposure is independently integrated every0.25s using interval-start states.
Per-flight1200s simulation-age deadline is a terminal task failure with zero bootstrap and no arrival bonus. A resource interruption is not a completed scenario.

Literal paper lane and native turn execution currently have unresolved corridor-containment limitations. Report width and altitude violations explicitly; this environment does not claim an operational safety guarantee.

Explicit terminal-definition diagnostic. A native route ending before this success condition becomes route_exhausted_without_arrival, with no arrival reward and zero terminal bootstrap. Its shorter exposure is not a safety improvement.

Finite exit replaces the 25m point-target condition with forward crossing of the fixed nominal final cross-section inside the original corridor width and height. Final-leg activation must already have occurred; an artificial capture does not erase that progress. Crossing location/altitude are interpolated within the physics tick; terminal exposure still retains the whole tick. Native passed alone is never success.

Combine the explicitly declared finite exit with settled vertical completion and final-leg capture guard. Preserve nominal routes, Table3 speeds and native bank25; compare individual semantic changes before further training.

Explicit ordinary-flyby current-state reconstruction: immediately before each native reached call, refresh only ordinary flyby turndist using current actual TAS, native bankdef, current waypoint bearing and next_qdr. Cached turnspd and selected target speed do not enter this formula. Reject flyturn and its transition modes; native reached alone determines waypoint passage. This follows the audited old author-fork formula, not a confirmed 2026 setup or a safety filter.

Retain Table3 speeds, native bank25, corridor dimensions, actions, observations, rewards and execution terminal policies. Corridor containment remains unresolved; existing whole-tick terminal exposure remains unchanged. The adapter is installed only for one environment step and restored before reset or caller-side sampling. Cumulative per-episode navigation_audit is available separately from the unchanged episode summary schema.

NR-only corner-speed execution via NominalTurnEnvironment. No traffic avoidance, learned model, speed-table/bank/route/width/termination edits. Requested nominal cruise stays unchanged; selected execution speed is limited for upcoming bends under native acceleration, then restored after turn completion.

The radius budget allocates half the corridor half-width to an ideal centreline fillet and at most45 percent of either adjacent leg to each tangent. This explicit engineering margin has no claimed continuous-time guarantee. Predictive braking covers native current-speed early passage. This autopilot behavior and continuous speeds below the discrete policy choices are not confirmed author2026 settings. Do not compare a learned policy using a different execution model.
